name: Wireless Sniffing
summary: Adversaries may seek to capture radio frequency (RF) communication used for remote control and reporting in distributed environments. RF communication frequencies vary between 3 kHz to 300 GHz, although are commonly between 300 MHz to 6 GHz. The wavelength and frequency of the signal affect how the signal propagates through open air, obstacles (e.g. walls and trees) and the type of radio required to capture them. analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies indirect evidence of passive RF capture on Industrial Control System (ICS) wireless frequencies -- an unassociated device's RF signature detected without a completed association sequence, or a known device's Media Access Control (MAC) address detected from a location/signal strength inconsistent with its registered installation point. analytics.name: Analytic 2134
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a process on an Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux asset setting a wireless interface to monitor mode via iwconfig or netlink calls, from a User Identifier (UID) not associated with documented wireless diagnostics. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.

analytics.name: Analytic 2272
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a Windows process enabling promiscuous or monitor mode on a wireless adapter on an Industrial Control System (ICS) workstation that is not a designated wireless management station, indicating preparation for wireless interception. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.
